Name: Four Portals Farm
Author: THEDEBAN
Description:
This map mod replaces the normal farmIt's similar to the four corners map but has 4 identical farms with portals in the middle of each to take the player to a court yard with 4 portals there.

To use the portals right click on them in the middle as though it was a door.(that's essentially what they are)
The exits to the farm are located next to the portal Court yard, the top and bottom paths are blocked with debris to add to the progression gameplay for those of us who have played stardew a few thousand times just to spice things up.

Grandpa's shrine is located up from the portal Court yard to the right of the path that leads to Robins.

The farm cave has had a substantial overhaul
Including a hot spring inside for regaining the farmers energy, you gain access to the farm cave after clearing the wooden stumps so a tool upgrade is required to lean more into the progression gameplay.

The Green house now has 4 crystals inside of it which will teleport the player to a separate room so now it can accommodate 4 players so they can have their own separate green house within one structure

Credits:
I used daisy nikos textures for the water falls 

The rest of the custom textures were drawn by myself.
